subject: Urgent: failed payment (3DS) — evidence & SCA fallback coordination
messages:
From: Sara Mason <sara@edgescale.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Failed charge on invoice RWD-3741 (3DS) — need next steps

Hi Dylan,

We had an invoice come through this morning (invoice RWD-3741, amount $12,450) but the card attempt failed in Stripe with a 3DS challenge that did not complete (decline code: card_decline_3ds_required). Our customer success team won't touch the card record unless we get explicit merchant authorization to retry or a fallback path.

Can Redwood:
- Confirm whether you can process as a merchant-initiated transaction (MIT) with the Authorization on file, or
- Provide the dispute/evidence bundle so we can reconcile internally in case this becomes a chargeback.

We have a customer claiming the payment didn't match their subscription — they may escalate. Attaching the Stripe receipt screenshot.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Mason
Revenue Ops | EdgeScale
Attachment: edgescale_attempt_receipt.png

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mason <sara@edgescale.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Failed charge on invoice RWD-3741 (3DS) — next steps & temporary credit offer

Hi Sara — thanks for flagging and for the receipt.

Short answer: we can provide an evidence package for a dispute and we can also initiate a merchant-initiated retry, but we need the customer's consent for MIT/SCA fallback. To keep the customer operational while this is sorted, we can apply a one-week courtesy credit for the disputed invoice if that helps avoid immediate churn.

Proposed plan:
1) You confirm whether EdgeScale will allow us to attempt MIT (they need to confirm authorization in writing).
2) Laura (CC'd) will prepare the evidence bundle: signed contract, invoice, usage logs, and the authorization metadata (IP, timestamp).
3) Vivek will open a Stripe disputes escalation ticket and submit the evidence; he can also request a manual reauthorization path with Stripe Billing if MIT is not possible.

If you want us to proceed with the courtesy credit now, tell me the preferred window and we'll apply it immediately.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Mason <sara@edgescale.com>

Date: 2026-08-05T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Failed charge on invoice RWD-3741 (3DS) — follow-up

Thanks Dylan.

EdgeScale is fine with a one-week credit while we investigate, but we cannot approve a blind retry. They told us the cardholder has already initiated a 'service not as described' claim internally, so if this turns into a chargeback we will need the full evidence set (contract, invoice, service logs showing usage during the billing period, and the original auth flow).

Could you include:
- Signed MSAs / PO associated with RWD-3741
- IP logs and session IDs for activity during 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31
- Any admin confirmations that the top-level account accepted the recurring billing terms

Attaching additional screenshot from our billing system. Please keep Stripe in the loop — I have put stripe-disputes@stripe.com on the thread for transparency.

Sara

Subject: Re: Failed charge on invoice RWD-3741 — evidence delivered & next steps

Hi Sara — thanks for the patience. Attached is the evidence bundle (invoice, signed MSA, usage summary, auth logs) referenced by Laura.

To avoid escalation to a chargeback we recommend either:
1) EdgeScale confirms merchant-initiated transaction authorization by replying to this email with the named admin's confirmation (we will annotate the Stripe reattempt with the authorization metadata), or
2) EdgeScale asks the cardholder to complete the 3DS challenge via the secure payment-update link — if they prefer to update the card we'll provide a transient token and guidance.

As a goodwill gesture we've applied a one-week credit that offsets the outstanding balance while you obtain authorization. If EdgeScale confirms MIT consent within 72 hours we'll attempt a single retry and keep Stripe informed. If we do not receive consent we will proceed with dispute submission to Stripe and include the attached evidence bundle.

Attachments: evidence_bundle.zip, invoice_RWD-3741.pdf, merchant_auth_log.csv

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
